reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the change adding canonical ATT&CK tactic ordering. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #558 by having the MITRE ATT&CK collector send explicit phase ordering, allowing the platform to display tactics in canonical matrix order rather than alphabetically. **Changes:** - Adds the canonical Enterprise ATT&CK tactic order to kill-chain phase upserts. - Places unknown tactics after all known tactics. - Adds regression coverage for phase ordering with reversed input and an unknown tactic. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `mitre-attack/​tests/​test_openaev_mitre.py` | Tests canonical phase values and unknown-tactic fallback ordering. | | `mitre-attack/​mitre_attack/​openaev_mitre.py` | Defines tactic ordering and includes `phase_order` in upsert payloads. |
Review effort: Balanced
